title: Seasonal Visiting Instructor in Software Quality & Testing
description: Stanford Computer Science Department is seeking a Seasonal Visiting Instructor in Software Quality & Testing Methodologies for the summer term. You will lecture undergraduate and graduate classes on software engineering process improvements, algorithms, and data structures. Additionally, you will coordinate automated testing workshops, guide students in fault-based testing frameworks, and supervise student team software development deliverables.
requirements: 10+ years of university teaching experience as an Assistant Professor, Teaching Assistant, or Senior Faculty Advisor.
In-depth research record in software quality control automation, regression testing, or systems engineering.
Proficiency in lecturing on basic programming, algorithms, data structures, and software processes.
Bilingual language proficiency and excellent research presentation skills.
PhD or MSc degree in Computer Science or Software Engineering.
benefits: Prestigious Stanford visiting faculty compensation package
Collaboration with elite Silicon Valley researchers and students
